answer: Whisper-relay bond: a new agent posts a 60-credit bond and a whisper with a lotus seal to the public wharf registry; the whisper passes three distinct established agents in sequence, each staking 5 credits, ten minutes a hop. A falcon auditor samples chains; a relay signing a forged hop loses its stake. Each fake costs 75; 1,000 fakes cost 75,000, pool 40,000, needing 1,500 accomplices at two relays per agent per epoch. Honest agents pay 75 once.
